acceptanceCriteria: New script scripts/shap_rollup.py reads reports/<sha>/<group>/*.json across the last N (default 5) 'keep' commits from results.tsv and computes per-domain top-10 features by sum of |shap| across all detections in those commits

stories.title: Deep orphan detection: scan history, not just HEAD
stories.note: _detect_deep_orphans() walks last 20 commits, flags hypothesis: with no paired baseline: and no results.tsv row. Pre-TSV-tracker commits filtered via awk cutoff on earliest tracked SHA. Warn-only (no auto-revert). Standalone-callable via `source run_autoresearch.sh`. False-positive guard is structural: only `hypothesis:` subjects match.
acceptanceCriteria: run_autoresearch.sh's orphan-detection step looks back up to N=20 commits (not just HEAD) for any 'hypothesis: …' commit that is NOT followed within 3 commits by a 'baseline: …' commit on the same branch AND does NOT appear in results.tsv as discard/keep/verify-fail
When such an orphan is found, wrapper logs a structured '.omc/autoresearch.log' entry with the orphan SHA, subject, and the detection reason (no paired baseline, not in results.tsv)

Wrapper DOES NOT auto-revert deep orphans (too dangerous — could discard human-authored commits like baseline-restore). Instead it writes a warning and continues. Only HEAD-level orphans (existing behavior) still auto-revert.

Unit-ish check: a shell helper function _detect_deep_orphans() is extracted and callable standalone; `bash -c 'source run_autoresearch.sh; _detect_deep_orphans 20'` prints zero or more warning lines to stderr and returns 0

False-positive guard: commits whose subject is 'baseline-restore:' or 'chore:' or 'refactor:' or 'feat:' or 'fix:' or 'test:' or 'docs:' are NEVER flagged (they're human-authored maintenance, not autoresearch hypotheses)

stories.title: Fix SIGPIPE (signal=141) at iteration.start — US-518 regression
stories.note: Root cause: run_autoresearch.sh line 746 `awk | sort | cut | head -5` under `set -euo pipefail`. `head -5` closes stdin after 5 lines; upstream `cut` races with sort's buffered output, occasionally receives SIGPIPE; pipefail propagates exit 141; set -e triggers EXIT trap; loop.crash signal=141 emitted. Fix: wrap the pipeline in a subshell with `set +o pipefail` so head-based truncation can't propagate as an error. Same pattern applied defensively to two other latent sites (line 325 _detect_deep_orphans, line 1204 RESULTS_TSV parse). Repro probe confirms fixed pipeline exits 0 under set -euo pipefail. selftest 3/3, pytest 49/49, audit 0.

stories.title: Prune feature_cache on discard path — prevent runaway growth during discard streaks
stories.note: Discovered during the 24h-stability monitor: with 9 consecutive discards post-SIGPIPE-fix, feature_cache grew 8 GB → 25 GB (disk 16 GB → 4.2 GB, below preflight 5 GB floor). Fix: invoke _prune_feature_cache_gb at top of while-loop (post-disk-check, pre-iteration.start), with OMC_FEATURES_PY_SHA unset so the guard uses post-reset (baseline) sha via git hash-object fallback.
